text:
meera: quick post-mortem from today's staging bring-up: new reranker variant shows NDCG@10 +0.7% but MRR@10 -1.1% on our curated holdout. short queries drive the MRR drop.
ajia: can you share eval settings? topk, tokenizer, quant flags?
meera: topk=10, holdout=45k, tokenizer=hf-roberta, ptq=int8, doc_trunc=1024. harness used stable_sort tie-breaker.
alex: that pattern usually means score collisions from quantization. stable tie-breaker makes MRR noisy when many candidates share the same discrete score. NDCG is less sensitive.
sam: quick checks: (1) run tie_strategy=avg and random(seed) in the harness; (2) compute tie_fraction = fraction of queries with >=2 equal topk scores; (3) inspect score histogram for spikes.
meera: ran a small local run (12k queries): stable mrr_delta=-1.12% (p=0.03), avg ties mrr_delta=-0.08% (p=0.47), random(seed=7) mrr_delta=-0.05% (p=0.49). tie_fraction=0.062 overall, short_queries tie_fraction=0.12. histogram shows clusters at 0.500 and 0.375.
jia: sounds conclusive. proposal: change offline CI default to tie_strategy=avg, keep production serving deterministic. add tie_fraction to CI artifacts and a dashboard panel; gate strict MRR alerts when tie_fraction>0.03 (or mark as tie-sensitive).
lucy: also note label pooling for webqa-like queries: multiple equivalent golds can amplify MRR sensitivity. log pooled_gold_count per query.
meera: I'll open a PR to add --tie-strategy flag with default=avg for offline runs, compute tie_fraction and pooled_gold_count, and include score_histogram. assigning: meera->PR+holdout run, alex->dashboard panel, sam->CI alert rule.
sam: add migration step to recompute 90-day baselines with avg ties to avoid alert flips.
alex: add short list of top-20 tie examples to the PR to help reviewers.
jeval-bot: ci artifact for preliminary run: /ci/artifacts/4250006789.json.
meera: thanks all, will follow up with PR link. :thumbsup:
